question: So what did she mean at the start when she was saying she wanted to test it? She wanted to see the result, but since Subaru was shaking fiercely and fell without being able to land safely, he died from the impact and she wasn’t able to tell?
answer: Due to the way Capella speaks, even when she has tested, it becomes the line “I wanted to test it.”. She can’t use the line “Even though I tested it.” since the result hasn’t occurred yet. I’m not really sure what you’re saying with the second part.
